mustPlays.name: Jahmyr Gibbs
mustPlays.why: Leads NFL in touches & TDs, ~30 DK pts/gm, top projection on the slate in the 54.5-total game. Every source has him #1.

mustPlays.name: Jacoby Brissett
mustPlays.why: $5,500 for a QB facing the defense allowing the most DK pts to QBs (28.9/gm). Cash lock per FantasyLabs, FantasyPros, Footballguys; FTN's top GPP QB by ROI.

mustPlays.name: Amon-Ra St. Brown
mustPlays.why: Top point-per-dollar WR (RotoWire), FTN's #1 WR by ROI; Arizona ranks last in yards per attempt.

mustPlays.name: Trey McBride
mustPlays.why: 7+ catches every game; Detroit allows the most DK pts to TEs (28.4). Stacks with Brissett.

core.name: Michael Wilson
core.why: 93.9% route rate, 30 targets in 2 games; DET allows 2nd-most DK pts to WRs.

core.name: Braelon Allen
core.why: Breece Hall out; played 94% of snaps last week. Best RB under $6K (rain risk).

core.name: D'Andre Swift
core.why: Monangai out; GB allows 2nd-most DK pts to RBs.

core.name: Sam LaPorta
core.why: ARI allows 3rd-most to TEs; ~1/3 of McBride's ownership (leverage).

core.name: Jared Goff
core.why: GPP pivot from Brissett: same shootout, ARI allowed 11 pass TDs.

stacks: Brissett + McBride + M. Wilson w/ Gibbs/St. Brown bring-back
Goff + St. Brown + LaPorta w/ McBride bring-back
Bears/Packers pivot: Love + Watson/Kraft w/ Swift

fades.name: Jaxon Smith-Njigba
fades.why: $8,800 in a tough SF matchup; St. Brown projects similar for $900 less (RotoWire)

fades.name: Garrett Wilson
fades.why: Overowned vs optimal in a 39.5 total (Stokastic)

fades.name: Ashton Jeanty
fades.why: GTD foot/ankle, DNP Friday - pivot to Mike Washington Jr. if out

default.notes: Lions-Cardinals (54.5) is 8 points higher than any other game, so the core lives there. Check inactives at 11:30am ET: Jeanty, Jefferson, Chase/Higgins, Stevenson, Dowdle.
